subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: After identity-safe removal is proven, should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core Claws status/remove and persisted ownership contract?
rationale: The protected draft introduces destructive core CLI and durable lifecycle semantics while the RFC and prerequisite stack remain unmerged.

options.title: Sponsor after safe deletion
options.body: Approve the lifecycle direction after the race is fixed and the stacked persistence and recovery contract is reviewed together.

options.title: Land status only
options.body: Keep read-only lifecycle visibility while deferring destructive removal until the broader contract is approved.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep the draft series unmerged until maintainers choose another lifecycle and ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after safe deletion
recommendation.body: Approve the lifecycle direction after the race is fixed and the stacked persistence and recovery contract is reviewed together.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing candidate across shared SQLite state, config mutation, and fs-safe infrastructure.
